tool_input.description: Move training band under its heading, save, validate

result:
Experiment 18's architecture figure is written to `runs/20261101_205738_experiment18/figure.json`. figcheck passes, and I rendered it and checked the picture.

Experiment 18 re-runs experiment 17's design with only a missing import fixed, so I reused experiment 17's figure from `experiments.sqlite` instead of drawing a new one. It shows two MobileNetV2 trunks, and the one change, concentric-ring pooling (112-d → 336-d), is marked in red in each. The camera frame and the (lat, lon, confidence) output are level on the centre line.

I made one layout fix. In experiment 17's figure, the "TRAINING SIGNALS — NEVER FLY" heading sat below the training text and shared its row with a footnote. It now sits above that text on its own row, and the dashed leader and glyph moved down with the text.

Three scratch files are still in the run directory: `_fix.py`, `fig17.svg` and `fig17.png`. The `rm` command asked for confirmation on each file, so they were probably not deleted. They are harmless and can be removed by hand. `fig18.svg` and `fig18.png` are the render of the final figure.
